verdict.rationale: Bento is an AI-agent observability and improvement platform, so a prompt playground is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions a playground for interactively running prompts against real models with variables. Prompt versioning, diffing, and release scoring are adjacent prompt-management features, not interactive iteration, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
